title: Muse Glimmer fits a 30B agentic AI on one consumer GPU under Apache 2.0
description:
Meta's Muse Glimmer fits a 30-billion-parameter agentic model on one consumer GPU under a fully open Apache 2.0 license. Distilled from the larger Muse Spark and trained across 100+ languages, the model handles multi-step tool use, failure recovery, and multimodal input, all downloadable from Hugging Face with zero access gates. Zuckerberg's paired 6,000-word essay argues superintelligence should be personal and decentralized across millions of devices. The weights already make that case concrete: once agentic capability reaches consumer hardware at this scale under an irrevocable license, the distribution of who can build and deploy AI shifts in ways no single institution can call back.

Click the Related Video button for the full episode, or use the link here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xSwmQTcbxLI
